note: Model families the ADLC workflow designer offers. This file is the source of truth: the gateway serves it through GET /api/workflows/catalog (modelFamilies), the designer populates Model family from it and filters the Model list by each family's providers, and the graph validator accepts exactly these ids (an unknown-but-well-formed id survives a save so removing a row never rewrites stored graphs). Add a row to add a family; set enabled:false to hide one from new selections. Every provider in agent/llm-presets.json must appear in exactly one family's providers (pinned by registry/model-families.test.js), except a provider listed in unassignedProviders below.
